0.0: Hm? Are you one of us? Wait, it doesn't even matter...just find me my arrows. I usually collect them right after I shoot them, but a few days ago, I wasn't feeling well so I didn't. This morning, I finally got out of bed and looked all over town for my arrows, but couldn't find them all. Now I'm missing some. Can you help me find them?

yes.0: I only use #b#t02060001##k. A true skillsman only uses the one type of arrow that fit them perfectly. Right now, I am missing #b10000#k arrows. Think that's a lot? In order to rescue Ariant from the queen, that's nothing. I use way more than that in a single day.
yes.1: Bring them to me once you find them all. You're my only hope.

no.0: People who constantly change their mind can't be trusted. I'll be keeping an eye on you from now on.

1.0: Great. Now I can continue to fight for Ariant. I will never forget what you've done for me. But, you didn't just buy any old arrows at a store, right? I make my own, so I can tell if you're trying to fool me... If you're trying to trick me, you will regret it.

yes.0: Mmm... These are it. All #b10000#k of them. Thank you.

item.0: Did you find all the arrows? Search carefully near town as well...
